FN-GFPGC66-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 147
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility Sponsor: Representative Phillip Pettus
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 147 as introduced would require purchases of supplies and services by volunteer fire
departments and rescue squads to be governed by current state law governing other local
government units. This bill would not otherwise directly affect state or local funding.

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Representative Phillip Pettus
Economic Development

services by volunteer fire departments and rescue squads to be governed by current state law
governing other local government units. This bill would not otherwise directly affect state or
local funding.
